profile.headline: Chief Software Engineer | Principal AI Systems Architect | Multi-Agent AI Systems · LLM Orchestration · Enterprise AI Platform Design | Leading Teams of Agents and People | Patent Inventor · 28 Years
profile.jobTitle: Chief Software Engineer | Principal AI Systems Architect
profile.summary:
Named inventor on patents in quantum-enhanced AI detection. Architect of a fully operational enterprise AI platform in active commercialization. Active FAA Public Trust clearance; Secret clearance reactivatable from prior defense work. Twenty-eight years spanning cryptographic foundations, quantum methods, hardware-level compute, multi-classification data systems, and multi-agent LLM orchestration — designing systems that improve decision quality, reduce uncertainty, and create compounded organizational leverage — from silicon to strategy — across defense-adjacent, national security, and enterprise AI environments.
 
Multi-agent AI systems and LLM orchestration are where my work is most alive. Coordinating role-specialized LLM agents through adversarial collaboration, quorum-based consensus, and dynamic orchestration produces gains in solution quality, reasoning depth, and convergence speed no single agent achieves alone. This society-of-mind approach transforms frontier LLMs from isolated tools into a collective intelligence engine — each agent's strengths amplify the others, weaknesses surface through structured critique, and solutions emerge more robust and reliable. The architecture is model-agnostic — agents are interchangeable implementation details; the orchestration logic is the innovation. Most AI platform architects design for a world where humans decide and AI assists. I am designing for the world arriving — where the architecture itself is the team, and the architect's job is to lead it. The same principles drive any team — agents, people, or both — beyond expectations. Leading all of them is what I do.
 
Current platform: continuous learning, real-time anomaly detection, domain-specific LLM, digital twin, zero trust security edge, live agentic specialist agents — in active commercialization. Teams I lead deliver on or ahead of schedule not by accident but by design.
 
Sovereign AI development environment — private compute cluster, hundreds of GB of VRAM, custom LLMs built and fine-tuned from the ground up. Career spans two commercial IP exits, DARPA-funded defense work, Navy national security infrastructure under Secret clearance, and an international IP acquisition by Agilent Technologies conditioned on my personal commitment to lead it.
 
M.S. Computer Science — DePaul University. B.S. Electrical Engineering — Western Michigan University. Two patents in quantum-enhanced AI detection, additional patent work pending.

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer | Principal AI Systems Architect
positions.description: Architectural lead and technical director for an advanced AI/ML research and development initiative focused on innovation at the frontier of agentic systems, continuous learning, and intelligent detection. Conceived the overarching system architecture, synthesized insights from subject matter experts and teammates to shape key technology decisions, and served as final decision-maker driving the work toward commercialization. Named inventor on two approved patents in quantum-enhanced AI detection methods, with additional patents in active development.
positions.insights: Skills: Multi-agent Systems · Quorum Based Consensus · AI System Architect · LLM Orchestration · Agentic AI · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Digital Twins · Machine Learning

positions.title: Principal Engineer | New Technology Architect
positions.description: Architected and integrated a real-time multi-modal threat detection and automated response platform protecting critical national infrastructure — detecting, classifying, and profiling threats across drone, human, vehicle, vessel, and projectile categories through simultaneous fusion of video analytics, seismic detection, acoustic sensing, facial recognition, and behavioral intent analysis. Designed permission-based identity matching enabling automated response triggering based on threat classification and profile. Served as lead technical architect during live Navy and TSA operational test events under Active Secret clearance. Continuously evaluated and integrated emerging detection technologies — LiDAR, edge-based video analytics, acoustic event detection, facial recognition, and advanced VMS platforms — to maintain state-of-the-art capability across protection perimeters spanning land, sea, and air threat vectors.
positions.insights: Skills: AI System Architect · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer | Data Communications Information Systems Team Lead | FAA clearance
positions.description:
Directed a full-scale platform modernization of a national airspace safety system — migrating mission-critical FAA data processing off a legacy stack onto a modern big data architecture built around ELK, Apache Spark, and RStudio. Designed the architecture, assembled and ramped the engineering team, and managed simultaneous pressure from internal leadership and the customer while maintaining delivery momentum across massive, high-velocity FAA data streams.
Architected live data correlation pipelines enabling near real-time situational markup — giving air traffic operators the ability to identify and respond to developing airspace situations as they were happening. System reliability was paramount: minimal downtime, continuous operation, and zero tolerance for data loss in an environment where accuracy directly supports the safety of airspace communications.
Delivered near schedule despite enormous technical and organizational complexity — reducing program costs by over 6% while producing a system so architecturally sound it remains the standing standard today with no plans to replace it. A testament to getting the design right the first time.
Led concurrent delivery of 8 major and 11 minor releases over a 9-month period with 85% on or ahead of schedule. Briefed directors, program management, and stakeholders weekly on status, risk, and path forward. Maintained FAA Public Trust clearance throughout.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer | My Florida Network | State of Florida Security Clearance
positions.description: Led architecture, design, implementation, testing, and verification of the integration interface for the State of Florida's networked services ordering system — enabling statewide government procurement of hardware, circuits, and IT services at scale. Delivered the system ahead of schedule, working near-independently with near-flawless results. Required and maintained State of Florida public trust clearance for MFN-2 network infrastructure access. The quality and speed of this delivery directly resulted in elevation to Chief Software Engineer in 2017.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer | National Security Systems | Secret Clearance
positions.description: Architected and led integration of a wide variety of sensors — seismic, supersonic, radar, and video — into a distributed mesh network enabling real-time identification of threats to national assets. Designed sensor interface modules across a redundant, encrypted mesh providing sensor health monitoring, automated failover, and near real-time event notification to operators securing areas of national interest. Built full-stack analytics and reporting environment enabling operators to configure, control, and monitor the complete sensor ecosystem. Maintained Secret clearance throughout.

positions.title: Founder | Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Founded and operated an AI/ML technical consultancy delivering advanced software engineering, data science, and applied research across five locations and international engagements — including defense-adjacent research, DARPA-funded programs, and multiple commercial IP exits.
DARPA drone predictive failure detection (2011–2013): Built a large-scale Hadoop cluster processing drone telemetry — applying ML to predict imminent failure by detecting thermal degradation in cathode and anode components during flight. Measurably reduced crash rates on a defense-critical program.
Autonomous Phytological Optimization System: Architected a wireless mesh network of sensor nodes — pH, light, humidity, soil moisture, temperature, and video — feeding a cloud-based ML system that continuously trained on collected data to autonomously optimize growing conditions per species. The system controlled watering, lighting, heat, and soil chemistry in real time based on what it learned. Video and imaging enabled continuous health and vibrance monitoring of plants, leaves, and fruit — with the AI prescribing and delivering exactly what each plant needed for optimal health. Applied continuous reinforcement learning before it was a common architectural pattern. IP sold commercially.
Human behavior modeling (2008–2010): AI/ML system mapping happiness, irritation, and dissatisfaction as a function of time allocation across life categories — using center-based constraint satisfaction to identify threshold crossings. Applied behavioral AI built before the pattern had a name.
ML investment engine: Production machine learning system delivering buy/sell signals — one of the earliest applied ML investment platforms. Thousands of subscribers. IP sold commercially.
Big data and predictive analytics across distributed cloud platforms. Data relationship discovery, statistical modeling, and visualization across multiple client engagements.
positions.insights: Skills: AI System Architect · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning

positions.title: International Business Developer | Product Owner | Technical Marketing Engineer
positions.description:
Appointed to lead Agilent's international push into automotive network analysis tooling following acquisition of the underlying IP — assessed market opportunities across European, Asian, and North American markets, defined hardware and software product requirements to meet evolving automotive communications standards, drove product-market fit, and established a sustainable business unit generating revenue across all three markets.
Authored internationally published technical papers and delivered major technical speaking engagements at premier automotive engineering forums across Europe and North America — including the European Automotive Testing Exposition in Stuttgart, the Integrated Electrical Solutions Forum in Paris, and the Agilent Measurement Journal. Established Agilent as the recognized technical authority in next-generation vehicle network analysis through a combination of published research and commanding international stage presence.

positions.title: International Business Developer | Product Owner | Technical Marketing Engineer
positions.description:
Served as product owner and technical authority for an automotive deterministic performance analyzer — defining feature requirements and behavioral specifications and driving delivery across software and hardware engineering teams. Recognized early that the product represented a strategic mismatch for Mentor Graphics as a pure software company and was tasked with finding the right acquirer while simultaneously building the market.
Executed aggressive international business development across Europe, Asia, and the United States — on the road across multiple countries weekly, relentlessly pursuing evaluations, trials, deals, and bundling opportunities at every level of the automotive engineering market. Applied engineering discipline and deep technical credibility to close — not just explaining the product but commanding the room well enough to generate sales across all three markets.
Identified Agilent Technologies as the strategic acquirer — a hardware-native company for whom this IP was a natural fit. Cultivated the relationship through major technical speaking engagements and international demonstrations that established the product as the definitive solution in its category. Closed the deal: an Agilent Technologies executive made acquisition of the IP conditional on a personal commitment to lead the initiative. The acquisition proceeded on that basis — a complete strategic exit executed while simultaneously building a global market from the ground up.

positions.title: Founder | Solution Architect | Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founded and built a commercial AI/ML investment intelligence platform from the ground up — conceiving, architecting, and implementing the entire system solo from first principles. At a time when machine learning was not yet a mainstream discipline, taught myself the mathematics, algorithms, and engineering required from a single reference text and translated that directly into a working production system.
The platform delivered real-time buy/sell signals on QQQQ — the NASDAQ-100 ETF — to thousands of paying subscribers. It operated reliably for years, maintaining subscriber trust and signal consistency across volatile and unpredictable market conditions. Every layer was built by hand: ML inference engine, fault-redundant data protection, full-stack front end, LAMP server infrastructure, SQL database architecture, and administrative tools suite.
Successfully wound down operations and sold the intellectual property for profit — a complete founder arc from concept through commercial operation through exit. This was the first proof that a single motivated engineer with deep enough commitment could build something of genuine commercial value from nothing. Every major success that followed traces back to what was learned here
positions.insights: Skills: AI System Architect · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Digital Twins · Machine Learning

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer | Senior Electrical Engineer | Real-Time Communication System
positions.description: Senior technical engineer responsible for system architecture of distributed communication systems under Deadline Monotonic Scheduling constraints — ensuring deterministic timing guarantees across safety-critical embedded environments. Designed network architectures, developed software, troubleshot complex communication systems, and delivered formal technical training to engineering teams. Work spanned both software and hardware disciplines across international engagements — building the embedded systems and real-time communications foundation that underpins every system architected since.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Team Leader | Product Owner
positions.description:
Began career as a software and hardware engineer developing embedded Controller Area Network (CAN) applications and PC networking analysis tools for the automotive industry — one of the most demanding real-time communications domains in engineering. Built deep expertise in formal documentation, requirements-based testing, customer technical support, and training delivery.
Earned promotion to Engineering Team Leader — taking on full responsibility for requirements capture, design translation, resource allocation, test planning, deployment, and onsite troubleshooting. Led engineering teams with the same discipline and rigor that would later define every system architected across a 28-year career.
Published and presented at the Society of Automotive Engineers in Detroit in 2002 — the first of many international technical publications and speaking engagements that established a pattern of recognized authority in every domain entered.

honors.title: Harris Engineering Award
honors.description: Engineering award rewarded for leadership and achievements enabling an aggressively targeted project to be achieved according to schedule.

publications.title: Diagnosing Root Causes and Resolving Communications Related Issues
